title: [review] schc_adaptation.json: Residue bit length mismatch for Rule 0
description: The listed fields sum to 174 bits (8+64+64+4+4+2+4+8+16), but residue_bit_length claims 200 bits. The provenance acknowledges this discrepancy but the explanation is unclear. Either additional fields are missing from the documentation, or the residue value is incorrect.
